facts.business: Quadrant Televentures Limited is a Unified License Services Licensee and Internet Service Provider in the Punjab Telecom Circle, providing Broadband Services on FTTH/DSL/VDSL technology, Fixed Voice (Landline) services, Internet Leased Line and P2P services.

auditor.name: Grant Thornton Bharat LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) material uncertainty on going concern basis due to continuous losses, erosion of net worth, current liabilities exceeding current assets, default on borrowings, and CIRP proceedings; (b) pending determination of obligations/liabilities for claims by operational/financial/other creditors and employees under CIRP; (c) finance cost of Rs. 5,849.35 Lakhs not provided in statement of profit and loss; (d) confidential CIRP information not provided to auditors, potential impact unascertained.

key_risks: Rapid adoption of cloud-based communication and digital workplace solutions threatening traditional telecom voice services
Emergence of new digital communication technologies intensifying competitive pressure
Convergence of connectivity with software-enabled services leading to pricing pressure and substitution of traditional voice services
Need for continuous investment in network modernization, cloud capabilities, digital platforms and value-added enterprise solutions to remain competitive
Failure to adapt service portfolio could adversely affect ability to retain enterprise customers and sustain revenues
